meta.note: Market BUY_PRODUCT/BUY_ANIMAL/SELL quantities are summed from dict actions {farmer,hands,market}. Money/herd from observation.farms tiles.

mechanisms.title: cows→milk→sell dominates wool
mechanisms.evidence: US 0 cows/0 milk all 5; opp 8-18 cows / 129-267 milk; mean bank gap ~$45k

mechanisms.title: early cow timing (day 0-5) vs sheep-gate
mechanisms.evidence: Opp first cow day 0 (4/5) or 5; US never buys cows

mechanisms.title: 2nd land unlocks herd+crops
mechanisms.evidence: US BUY_LAND=1→2 quads; opp usually BUY_LAND=2→3 quads (4/5)

mechanisms.title: market/grown wheat buffer for dairy feed
mechanisms.evidence: US wheat buys 49-89; typical winners 86-465 (JCN churn 6402; Sarthak 0 market + grown)

mechanisms.title: milk compounds after day 15
mechanisms.evidence: Mean day15→25: opp +$47k vs US +$19k; crossover ~day 10-20

mechanisms.title: CARE/FEED intensity on dairy herd
mechanisms.evidence: Winners FEED+CARE >> US; US CARE often 0

mechanisms.title: strawberry secondary cash
mechanisms.evidence: Opp strawberry sells mean 77 vs US 28

mechanisms.title: sheep placement stall under pasture/land cap
mechanisms.evidence: US buys 7-8 sheep but tiles show ~3-5 through day 25

mechanisms.title: hire count not causal
mechanisms.evidence: HIRE ~282 both sides; labor allocation differs
